evidence.quote:

passed M1, this confirms whether the final textual response
  describes the retrieved data without distortion.

practical_problems.note: M3 checks ADX results against manually computed ground truth and M4 checks response faithfulness, on 90 LLM-synthesized questions

summary: Automates sleep-data question answering through NL-to-KQL grounding and scheduled monitoring; a preliminary synthetic-query validation reports M1-M4 pipeline correctness and faithfulness without baselines.
